lines.text: Many learners say: We go to the park in the weekend.
Better: We go to the park on the weekend.
On! I rest on the weekend.

en.hook: In the weekend or on the weekend?
en.tip: For the weekend, use “on”: “We go to the park on the weekend.”
en.caption: Do you also say “We go to the park in the weekend”? 😅 In Russian «в выходные» starts with «в», so “in” feels right, but American English says “on the weekend.” Correct: “We go to the park on the weekend.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
